# Pixel Hangman

A fully offline, responsive pixel-art hangman game built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

## Features
- Built-in word list (30+ words)
- Letter buttons A–Z with keyboard accessibility
- Canvas-drawn hangman that grows with wrong guesses (up to 6)
- Win/lose messages and New Game button
- Cohesive palette and responsive layout (works from 360px wide)

## How to Run
1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. No server or network required.

## Controls
- Click letter buttons or use keyboard (Tab to focus, Enter/Space to press)
- Click "New Game" to reset

## Files
- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – game logic
- `README.md` – this file
